title: handoff.md (plan/sub-plan) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for plan-tree handoff.md files. Strict append-only newest-first per the session-continuity protocol.

_design_notes.consumer: hooks/pre-write-guard.sh (heading-shape check via section_schema; append-only is documentary — no write-time DENY, per evolution_protocol) + librarian session-close + librarian plan-handoff-index
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: Append-only; historical session entries never edited in place. R-37 atomic lockstep — documentary-by-design (the append-only invariant is the lockstep record, NOT a write-time DENY).

append_only_rationale: No in-place edits to historical session entries. New session entries prepend at top (newest-first). Historical entries are immutable record of plan execution arc.
newest_first_rationale: Repository convention — readers scroll top to find latest session; pre-existing entries shift downward without modification.
section_schema_rationale: Heading shapes the chronicle recognizer (handoff-chronicle-append.sh SESSION_HEADING_RE) accepts: '## Session <N> — ...', '## Session S<N> — ...', '## Session <YYYY-MM-DD> — ...' (date is the sort-key, not the ordinal), '## Session: ...', '## Alignment Session <N> — ...', bare '## S<N> — ...', or date-prefixed '## <YYYY-MM-DD> — ...'. Contract<->recognizer agreement so a conforming append is never dropped from the handoff-chronicle; enforced write-time by pre-write-guard.sh.
